item.title: Obituary: Lois R. Sheley
item.description: Lois R. “Lou” Sheley, 90, of Minden, Louisiana was born on September 21, 1935, in Heflin, Louisiana and entered into rest on December 3, 2025, in Minden, Louisiana. item.title: Louisiana becomes first state approved for $1.36 billion in federal broadband funding
item.description: BATON ROUGE, La— Gov. Jeff Landry announced recently that Louisiana is the first state in the country to receive federal approval of its final proposal to deploy $1.355 billion in Broadband, Equity, Access, and Deployment (BEAD) funding.
